notes: When updating the baseline, compare the published SDK types, verify the consumed protocol against the matching CLI, recapture lifecycle.json, and run the Claude driver tests. The thinking turn was recorded with --thinking-display summarized on a model that emits thinking text for a short reasoning prompt (claude-sonnet-4-6; Claude 5 adaptive thinking produced none). Recorded lines keep their envelope (type, subtype, uuid, session_id, parent_tool_use_id) and the fields protocol.go decodes, and Anthropic stream events stay as sent without usage; system/init keeps only model, version, capabilities and permission mode, the result keeps only token counts, cost and diagnostics are dropped, and thinking signatures read <signature>. Workspace CLI installation is managed separately.
